# verb-conservation record — project=templates/go/http-gateway profile=pass
# every gate tool exits 0; each block is one verb: its exit code, then the argv
# of every external gate tool it invoked, in order.

### verb build
exit 0
go	build ./...

### verb test
exit 0
go	test ./... -race -count=1

### verb lint
exit 0
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s --config <sandbox>/tree/.golangci.yml ./...

### verb vet
exit 0
go	vet ./...

### verb fmt
exit 0
gofumpt	-w .

### verb cover
exit 0
go	test ./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=<sandbox>/http-gateway-cover.<tmp>
go	tool cover -func=<sandbox>/http-gateway-cover.<tmp>

### verb generate
exit 127
go	run ./tools/openapi -mode emit -out contract/openapi.yaml

### verb openapi
exit 0
go	run ./tools/openapi -mode emit -out contract/openapi.yaml

### verb verify-openapi
exit 0
go	run ./tools/openapi -mode verify -out contract/openapi.yaml

### verb gen-client
exit 0
oapi-codegen	--config <sandbox>/tree/templates/go/http-gateway/clients/go/oapi-codegen.yaml <sandbox>/tree/templates/go/http-gateway/clients/go/../../contract/openapi.yaml

### verb integration
exit 0
go	test -tags integration ./... -race -count=1

### verb vuln
exit 0
govulncheck	./...

### verb sast
exit 0
gosec	-quiet ./...

### verb secretscan
exit 0
gitleaks	detect --no-git --redact --source .

### verb maintainability
exit 0
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s --config <sandbox>/tree/.golangci.yml ./...
hnslint	./...

### verb phase-gate
exit 0
go	build ./...
go	run ./tools/openapi -mode verify -out contract/openapi.yaml
go	build ./...
go	vet ./...
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s --config <sandbox>/tree/.golangci.yml ./...
go	test ./... -race -count=1
go	test ./... -race -count=1
go	test -tags integration ./... -race -count=1
go	test ./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=<sandbox>/http-gateway-cover.<tmp>
go	tool cover -func=<sandbox>/http-gateway-cover.<tmp>
govulncheck	./...
gosec	-quiet ./...
gitleaks	detect --no-git --redact --source .
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s --config <sandbox>/tree/.golangci.yml ./...
hnslint	./...
rg	-n --glob !*_test.go --glob !**/generated/** -e panic\("unimplemented"\) -e TODO -e FIXME -- internal cmd

### verb phase-gate architecture

go	build ./...
go	run ./tools/openapi -mode verify -out contract/openapi.yaml
